committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 7 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend last7 sits at $139.74 against $119.09 prior, with cpc at $6.08 and conversions still at zero; the landing-page test has only used $20.91 of the $600 promo credit, leaving $524.90 ex GST.
The dedicated review page has pulled 11 sessions and one ask_cta_click since launch on Tue 6, with zero review_cta_click so far; raw paid clicks for the test sit at 3 of the 25-click review window.
generate_lead held at zero across last7 even as formStartsLast7 hit 3; no new enquiry has appeared yet to grade against the qualified rule.

Organic Search sessions more than doubled to 15 from 6, the only trustworthy unpaid signal; AI Assistant sessions rose to 3 from 2 (top source claude-check), but this almost certainly undercounts given Direct jumped to 34 from 13.

actions.text: Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding; sort these while spend is modest.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update these to match the current site stats.
